name: AUM Saha Navavatu
text:
ॐ सह नाववतु ।
सह नौ भुनक्तु ।
सह वीर्यं करवावहै ।
तेजस्वि नावधीतमस्तु मा विद्विषावहै ।
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
meaning: May we, teacher and student, be protected together, nourished together; may we work together with energy; may our learning be filled with brilliance; may we not have discord with each other. Peace, peace, peace.
purpose: A peace invocation for shared learning and protection.
supports: Learning with others; harmony; respect between teacher and student.
when: Before a class or study together.
source: Peace invocation of the Taittiriya and Katha Upanishads

parts.meaning: May we (teacher and student) be protected together.
May we work together with great energy.
May our learning be filled with brilliance.
May we not have discord with each other.
Peace, peace, peace: in the body, the mind and all around.
